b01-letter-i.observed_description: One square white card taped flat at its top edge to a white classroom whiteboard shows one large bold black serif capital letter I with short serifs, alone in the photo. No corner marks and nothing else written; the classroom is softly blurred. No people.
b01-letter-i.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only, never in a four-picture grid). Every letter is correct, in order, sharp and plainly readable at 180 px; no other writing.

b02-letter-h.observed_description: One square white card taped flat at its top edge to a white classroom whiteboard shows one large bold black printed capital letter H, alone in the photo. Nothing else written; the classroom is softly blurred. No people.
b02-letter-h.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only, never in a four-picture grid). Every letter is correct, in order, sharp and plainly readable at 180 px; no other writing.
